# dodopayments_brand (Resource)

Manages a brand. The API does not delete a brand. When Terraform destroys the resource, the provider archives the brand. The API cannot restore an archived brand.

!> **Destroy behavior:** The API does not delete a brand. When Terraform destroys the resource, the provider archives the brand. The API cannot restore an archived brand.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "dodopayments_brand" "example" {
  description   = "Managed by Terraform"
  name          = "example-brand"
  support_email = "support@example.com"
  url           = "https://example.com/example-brand"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `description` (String) If you remove this attribute from the configuration, the API keeps the last value.
- `name` (String) If you remove this attribute from the configuration, the API keeps the last value.
- `statement_descriptor` (String) If you remove this attribute from the configuration, the API keeps the last value.
- `support_email` (String) If you remove this attribute from the configuration, the API keeps the last value.
- `url` (String) If you remove this attribute from the configuration, the API keeps the last value.

### Read-Only

- `archived_at` (String) Time the brand was archived. Null for an active brand.
- `brand_id` (String)
- `business_id` (String)
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `id` (String) The ID of the object.
- `image` (String)
- `reason_for_hold` (String) Incase the brand verification fails or is put on hold.
- `verification_enabled` (Boolean)
- `verification_status` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = dodopayments_brand.example
  identity = {
    id = "<id>"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) The ID of the brand.

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = dodopayments_brand.example
  id = "<id>"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a brand by its ID.
terraform import dodopayments_brand.example <id>
```
